parameters.name: CheckPoint
parameters.description:
The checkpoint of the incremental write module. The value is a UNIX timestamp.

> Default value: the checkpoint that is automatically saved by DTS when the original task is stopped.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the task generated by calling the **CreateReverseDtsJob** operation.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. This is a global parameter and does not need to be passed in for this operation.
